It also appears as a card in the TCG. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|DP}}==== Roark found Rampardos as a Cranidos during his childhood when it was still a [[Fossil]]. It was the first Pokémon to be restored from a Fossil by scientists in [[Oreburgh City]]. [[File:Roark and Rampardos.png|thumb|220px|left|Rampardos and Roark]] Cranidos debuted in ''[[DP015|Shapes of Things to Come!]]'', where Roark used it as the third and final Pokémon against [[Paul]]. It knew some powerful attacks, such as {{m|Zen Headbutt}}. Cranidos fought against [[Paul's Chimchar]] and Paul allowed Chimchar to get hit repeatedly by its Zen Headbutt. This caused Chimchar to activate {{a|Blaze}}, which powered up his {{type|Fire}} moves. Even though this gave Chimchar the upper hand, it was still not enough, as Cranidos managed to defeat Chimchar with {{m|Headbutt}} after Chimchar executed Dig. Cranidos then went up against {{TP|Paul|Elekid}}, who took damage earlier from its battle with Roark's {{p|Onix}}. During the battle, Elekid pounded Cranidos's knee, which caused it to reel in pain. Despite Elekid's {{a|Static}} [[Ability]] {{status|Paralysis|paralyzing}} Cranidos, it was canceled out by Cranidos's Ability, {{a|Mold Breaker}}. Cranidos still suffered from the added pain on its knee and then clashed with Elekid's {{m|Brick Break}} with its Zen Headbutt. Both Pokémon stood up and Cranidos fell, thus losing to Elekid, but not without giving a fierce battle. [[File:Roark Rampardos Mold Breaker.png|thumb|220px|Activating {{a|Mold Breaker}}]] In ''[[DP016|A Gruff Act to Follow!]]'', Roark used it as his first Pokémon against {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Aipom}}. It surprised everyone by jumping into the air and Headbutting Aipom just as she was about to charge in with {{m|Focus Punch}}. Aipom's Focus Punch was interrupted after she was hit by a Headbutt. It wasn't long until Cranidos was able to defeat Aipom despite Aipom's use of {{m|Double Team}}. Cranidos battled {{AP|Pikachu}} next. It overpowered Pikachu at first even though Pikachu had used {{m|Thunderbolt}} and {{m|Iron Tail}} on it before, assuming that it would slow down. This caused Paul to leave but Pikachu's fighting spirit convinced him to stay. Ash recalled Pikachu and sent out {{AP|Turtwig}}. Cranidos countered Turtwig's {{m|Razor Leaf}} attack with Flamethrower, burning up the leaves produced by the attack. Cranidos's combination of Zen Headbutt and Flamethrower nearly took out Turtwig but Turtwig survived them and Cranidos lost to Turtwig's Razor Leaf flurry. However, the impact of the battle weakened both Turtwig and Pikachu enough so that Roark's Onix could finish them off, thus defeating Ash. In ''[[DP017|Wild in the Streets!]]'', Cranidos was sent out to deal with a rampaging {{p|Kabutops}} and {{p|Armaldo}}. {{TRT}}'s intervention gave [[Dr. Kenzo]] and another scientist a chance to recall them into their Poké Balls. Cranidos briefly took on {{p|Aerodactyl}} and stopped its {{m|Giga Impact}} from attacking any further. It then battled Team Rocket and {{MTR}} fired his net at it. After hearing Roark call out to it, Cranidos begins [[Evolution|evolving]] into Rampardos and defeats the trio with a Zen Headbutt after getting the Fossil revival machine back from them. [[File:Roark Rampardos and Byron Bastiodon.png|thumb|220px|Rampardos and Bastiodon]] Ash then challenged Roark for a rematch in ''[[DP018|O'er the Rampardos we Watched!]]''. Rampardos became the last Pokémon Ash faced. Since both {{p|Aipom}} and {{p|Pikachu}} dealt with {{p|Geodude}} and Onix previously, they were unable to handle Rampardos's power which caused Rampardos to easily defeat them. During its battle with Turtwig, Rampardos almost defeated {{p|Turtwig}}, but Turtwig managed to emerge victorious once again due to quick thinking on Ash's part, earning Ash the {{badge|Coal}}. In ''[[DP107|Ancient Family Matters!]]'', it battled [[Byron's Bastiodon]]. However, the match was interrupted due to Team Rocket trying to steal Byron's Fossil collection. It then teamed up with {{p|Bastiodon}} to send the trio blasting off and retrieve the Fossils. Rampardos briefly appeared alongside Roark during the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''. ====Personality and characteristics==== Ever since Cranidos was revived from a Fossil, it became Roark's most relied-on Pokémon. During the battles between Paul and Ash, it was able to hold its own against them, even forcing the opponent down to one Pokémon. During Cranidos's first battle against Ash, it nearly defeated him on its own but lost to Turtwig. {{color2|000|Pokémon Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl}} |} ==In the manga== [[File:Roark Rampardos Adventures.png|180px|thumb|left|Rampardos in Pokémon Adventures]] [[File:Roark Cranidos Egg Adventures.png|thumb|180px|As an Egg]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Roark Cranidos Adventures.png|thumb|left|175px|As a Cranidos]] Roark received Rampardos as an {{pkmn|Egg}} prior to the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. He hatched into a Cranidos sometime after. In ''[[PS341|Putting a Crimp in Kricketot]]'', Cranidos walked out of the [[Oreburgh Mine]] along with his Trainer. In ''[[PS342|A Conk on Cranidos's Cranium]]'', Roark sent Cranidos out as his first Pokémon during {{adv|Platinum}}’s Gym battle with him. Cranidos fought against {{TP|Platinum|Piplup}}. After he managed to do heavy damage to her with a supereffective {{m|Shock Wave}}, both Roark and Platinum immediately recalled their Pokémon and sent out {{p|Onix}} and {{TP|Platinum|Ponyta}} in their stead. Following the defeat of Onix, Roark sent out Cranidos again. Cranidos used {{m|Double Team}} which gave Piplup problems. He continued to use Double Team and attempted a {{m|Zen Headbutt}}. However, Piplup used {{m|Water Pulse}} earlier which caused Cranidos to get {{status|confusion|confused}}. The confusion caused Cranidos to hurt himself and eventually faint. Cranidos reappeared in ''[[PS374|Brash Bronzong I]]'' alongside his Trainer. During a talk with Mr. Foreman, Cranidos evolved into a {{p|Rampardos}}, something that Roark expected. Rampardos reappeared in [[Byron]]'s imagination in ''[[PS404|Encountering Elekid]]'' alongside Roark and Onix. In ''[[PS410|Creeping Away from Cradily]]'', Rampardos participated in the final battle alongside the Gym Leaders’ other Pokémon against [[Saturn]], [[Mars]], and [[Jupiter]]. It was revealed [[PS412|later]] on that Roark was able to defeat Saturn. However, the [[Red Chain]] bound Rampardos and the others in an attempt to stop [[Cyrus]]. Rampardos and the other Pokémon worked together to free themselves from the Red Chain. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|rock||Roark Cranidos {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Shock Wave|1=Double Team|2=Zen Headbutt}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Shock Wave|1=Double Team|2=Zen Headbutt}} as a Cranidos}} {{anmov|Electric|Shock Wave|PS342|A Conk on Cranidos's Cranium}} {{anmov|normal|Double Team|PS342|A Conk on Cranidos's Cranium}} {{anmov|psychic|Zen Headbutt|PS342|A Conk on Cranidos's Cranium}} {{anmov/f|rock}} ===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!=== [[File:Roark Cranidos DPA.png|thumb|200px|Cranidos in Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!]] Roark's Cranidos was first used in ''[[DPA02|Hareta's Very First Pokémon Battle!!]]'' to rescue Hareta after he had been captured by two {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s. Afterwards, Roark used Cranidos in Hareta's Gym battle against him and lost to his {{TP|Hareta|Piplup}} thanks to the [[Oran Berry]] that Roark had given to Hareta earlier. In ''[[DPA22|Bonds Connect Across Space-Time...]]'', Cranidos joined the other Gym Leaders' Pokémon in attacking {{p|Palkia}} in order to protect Hareta. However, Palkia easily cancelled out all the attacks thrown at it. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|rock||Roark Cranidos {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Take Down|1=Headbutt|2=Assurance}} DPA.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Take Down|1=Headbutt|2=Assurance}}}} {{anmov|normal|Take Down|DPA02|Hareta's Very First Pokémon Battle!!}} {{anmov|normal|Headbutt|DPA02|Hareta's Very First Pokémon Battle!!}} {{anmov|dark|Assurance|DPA02|Hareta's Very First Pokémon Battle!!}} {{anmov/f|rock}} ===Pocket Monsters DP=== [[File:Roark Cranidos PMDP.png|thumb|200px|Cranidos in Pocket Monsters DP]] Roark's Rampardos appeared as a Cranidos in [[PMDP07]]. {{sectionstub}} ==In the TCG== Roark's Rampardos is featured in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] as a {{TCG|Pokémon GL|Pokémon}} {{SP|GL}}.
